reviews.text: My favourite lip tint. I wear it everyday. It is long lasting and a beautiful colour.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅唇釉。每日都用。持久度高，顏色又靚。

reviews.text: Beautiful! The formula is pleasant to apply and looks smooth and shiny. It is very comfortable and does not dry the lips at all. You can build up the colour to your own preference. I recommend and I will be getting more colours.
reviews.zh: 好靚！質地搽上手好舒服，睇落平滑又有光澤。完全唔會令嘴唇乾燥，著感好舒服。可以因應自己喜好疊加顏色。推薦，我會再入手其他色。

reviews.text: 色はとても可愛くてお気に入りなのですが、液漏れがひどいです。ポーチに入れて持ち歩きたかったのに残念です。
reviews.zh: 顏色好可愛，本係心水，但漏液好嚴重。本想放入小袋帶出街，可惜。

reviews.text: smaller than I expected but really cute! the smell is sweet & easy to pack up in bag
reviews.zh: 比預期細小，但真係好得意！味道甜甜哋，又容易放入袋。

reviews.text: It’s quite thick therefore long lasting and i really like the gloss. The colour is also really nice
reviews.zh: 質地幾厚身，所以幾持久，光澤感我都好鍾意。顏色都好靚。

reviews.text: So cute and mini, the color is okay I wish it was more muted but I fell for the size of it
reviews.zh: 好得意又迷你，顏色 OK，如果再啞色少少就更好，不過我係俾佢個尺寸吸引咗。

reviews.text: IT'S SOOOO CUTE, love the color, perfect for keeping it in my backpack (everywhere really)
reviews.zh: 超級得意，鍾意呢個顏色，放書包啱啱好（真係邊度都帶得）。

reviews.text: Love this so much. Cute packaging, great color. I accidentally bought mini, so I need to get another one lol
reviews.zh: 超鍾意。包裝得意，顏色靚。本來唔小心買咗迷你裝，要再買返個正常 size lol

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
